senses.definition: no longer in your possession or control; unable to be found or recovered
spiritually or physically doomed or destroyed
not gained or won
people who are destined to die soon
examples: the agony of the doomed was in his voice

senses.definition: having lost your bearings; confused as to time or place or personal identity
examples: I frequently find myself disoriented when I come up out of the subway
the anesthetic left her completely disoriented

senses.definition: cannot be recovered or regained
not caught with the senses or the mind
deeply absorbed in thought
examples: as distant and bemused as a professor listening to the prattling of his freshman class

senses.definition: perplexed by many conflicting situations or statements; filled with bewilderment
examples: she felt lost on the first day of school

senses.definition: unable to function; without help
fail to keep or to maintain; cease to have, either physically or in an abstract sense
examples: She lost her purse when she left it unattended on her seat

senses.definition: fail to win
examples: We lost the battle but we won the war

senses.definition: suffer the loss of a person through death or removal
examples: She lost her husband in the war
The couple that wanted to adopt the child lost her when the biological parents claimed her

senses.definition: miss from one's possessions; lose sight of
allow to go out of sight or mind
examples: The detective lost the man he was shadowing after he had to stop at a red light
lose the crowds by climbing a mountain

senses.definition: fail to make money in a business; make a loss or fail to profit
examples: I lost thousands of dollars on that bad investment!
The company turned a loss after the first year

senses.definition: fail to get or obtain
examples: I lost the opportunity to spend a year abroad

senses.definition: fail to perceive or to catch with the senses or the mind
examples: We lost part of what he said

senses.definition: withdraw, as from reality
examples: he lost himself in his music

senses.definition: be set at a disadvantage
examples: This author really suffers in translation
The painting loses something in this light
